title: nutty silky chinese puy-lentils zhu yu
description: a nutty, silky chinese dish featuring puy lentils, perfect for a weekend brunch. inspired by ayurvedic rajasic principles, this recipe promotes balance and harmony in the body.
instructions: heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
add the puy lentils, stirring to coat with the ghee, and cook for 1 minute.
add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee in a small skillet over medium heat.
add the sliced scallions and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
stir in the soy sauce and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
stir the cooked scallion mixture into the cooked lentils and season with salt to taste.
serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
